sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Taijutsu, Wind Release, Fire Release, Stable, Clash

system.description:
You conjure multiple globes of superheated flame and coat your arm before extending it into the shape of flaming spear.

Make a melee ninjutsu (or taijutsu) attack, comparing the result against all creatures in a 20-foot long, 5-foot-wide line, originating from you. On a hit, you deal your [Unarmed Damage] + 4d10 fire damage and force the affected creatures to make a Constitution saving throw, being Immolated on a failure.

You can repeat this attack, as an Action on each of your turns.

Scorch. By spending any number of Scorch Charges, you extend your spear by +10 feet for every charge spent. Additionally, if a creature is within 5 feet when you cast this jutsu you can roll 1 additional 1d20, using either d20 result vs only that creature of your choice.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, and the damage it deals by 1d10.
